topic: Replay of terms verdicts and redacted fields
detail: Low (SP-044 review round 1, RC-116): replay cannot run the terms check again (the log never keeps the text, INV-07, and the checkout moves on), so it carries a recorded outbound_term or outbound_unchecked refusal while the replayed guard lets the call through and the terms layer is on. Replay and orchd's logging-mode verdicts are also computed on redacted directories and targets, so a root or repo whose name is a term can replay differently from the live verdict.
